page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs, representing 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 128.0 GB of RAM. This configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it has a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively, and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by middle-tier scores in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is also average, reaching 75.3 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its high memory density and moderate multi-core compute capabilities, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding extreme single-thread CPU performance. It is well-suited for memory-intensive applications such as database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and moderate multi-threaded data processing. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or workloads requiring local high-speed NVMe storage.
